posts.content_md:
Greetings Colin!

I hope this email finds you and the Holography Forum well. I noticed it was down today. A special thanks, again, to you and Mike for managing the Forum. Many of the customers we refer to your Forum subsequently tell us how valuable they found your forum to be once they've visited it. 

I'm writing you to share with you some significant discounts on the PFG-04 dichromated gelatin plates we have in stock. Please feel free to share this information with Forum members, since I think there are several that may be interested. Forum members can learn more about the discounts by clicking on the Integraf banner on the top of your Forum pages. 

We had a deal fall through, so we're got some over-stock PFG-04 in 2.5"x2.5" (30 per box) discounted at $75 ($71.25 for registered Forum members), and 4"x5" (25/box) at $100 ($95 for registered Forum members). As you know, the "freshness" of the PFG-04 plates drops about 5% per month after its date of manufacturer, so we're putting them on discount. The 2.5" plates are still quite fresh, manufacturered in late August, while the 4x5s were manufactureed in February 2005. We store the plates in refrigeration at about 5 degree Celsius.

Thanks, again, Colin. It's a pleasure to serve you and the Forum, as always.

Best regards,

Alec
